p.d: A look back at the best goals from the 2005/06 season. Thierry Henry became the first player in the league's history to win the Golden Boot four times, top-scoring with 27 goals.

p.t: Premier League Goals of the Season
p.d: A look back at the best goals from the 2006/07 season. Chelsea's Didier Drogba topped the scoring charts with 20 goals, ahead of Benni McCarthy (18) and Cristiano Ronaldo (17).

p.t: Premier League Goals of the Season
p.d: A look back at the best goals from the 2007/08 season. Cristiano Ronaldo topped the scoring charts with a remarkable 31 goals, ahead of Fernando Torres and Emmanuel Adebayor on 24.

p.t: Premier League Goals of the Season
p.d: A look back at the best goals from the 2008/09 season. Chelsea striker Nicolas Anelka secured the Golden Boot with 19 goals, beating Cristiano Ronaldo to the prize.

p.t: Premier League Goals of the Season
p.d: We revisit the best goals from the 2009/2010 season. In his most prolific season for Chelsea, Didier Drogba secured the Golden Boot with 29 goals, three ahead of Wayne Rooney.
